name: Nango — Google Calendar
description: Google Calendar access through Nango OAuth. Registers one provider tool whose credentialRef is the stable nango://google-calendar ref (Nango holds the OAuth credential — no vault secret). The dispatcher resolves the user's most-recent google-calendar connection (Connection-Id + Provider-Config-Key) and proxies requests to the Google Calendar API. PRECONDITION: a Nango integration with providerConfigKey 'google-calendar' must already exist and the acting user must have connected their Google account via Settings -> Connectors. Calendar code skills (create event, list agenda) are NOT seeded here — those connector operations are not yet built; this template establishes the connection + auth so those skills can land later.

tools.name: calendar
